_comment: The evaluateTransaction `additionalUtxo` request shape, captured from live Ogmios v6.14.0 (preprod) on 2026-06-01 by strict-validation probing (NOT guessed). Each entry resolves an input that isn't on the ledger yet (a chained tx's not-yet-confirmed ancestor output). Evidence: a malformed entry returns JSON-RPC -32600 (schema reject) BEFORE the tx is decoded; the shape below returns -32602 (tx-level), i.e. it passed schema. Strictness confirmed: `value` as a bare number -> 'parsing Value failed, expected Object'; missing `index` -> 'field index not found'; `value` must be the nested object form `{ada:{lovelace}, <policyHex>:{<nameHex>:qty}}`. Optional per-entry: `datum` (inline-datum hex CBOR), `datumHash` (hex), `script`. Unknown fields are ignored.
